why_this_file_exists: the cost block of o1_result.json triples the whole physical bill, which charges each arm's own designs three times; the preregistered model triples only the shared support block. o1_result.json is bound by the batch record and the upload receipt, so it is left byte-identical and the recomputation is recorded here.

recomputed_numbers.direction_of_the_difference: the reported figure is larger, i.e. it overstates cost; it never flatters an arm

cap_checks.check: three-arm charged equivalent starts within cap
three-arm charged internal cases within cap
physical bill equals the preregistered prediction
contract-reading equivalent bill equals the preregistered model
charged internal equals the preregistered model

which_numbers_the_caps_are_judged_agains: the per-arm charged figures (16 equivalent starts, 160 internal cases, 8 designs) and their three-arm sums (48 / 480 / 24), because those are the quantities the cap keys name; on the contract reading the bill matches the preregistration exactly
disclosure: the discrepancy is disclosed, not repaired in place: the batch is closed and uploaded, and rewriting o1_result.json would change a hash that o1_batch_close.json, the A4 recompute and the upload receipt already cite
does_the_discrepancy_flatter_any_arm: no; it inflates the total, and every per-arm number used for the comparison is unaffected
